chatHistory.content:
8-second b-roll animation, minimal text, visual-first. Complements voiceover about connecting an Apify scraper to downstream   systems. Apify brand styling, dark background, subtle ambient motion.
  Concept: a central scraper node sits in the middle of the frame. As the narration progresses, connection lines extend outward
   one by one to surrounding destination nodes — each destination represented by an abstract glyph, not literal logos.
           Beats:

  - 0:00–0:01 — Central node springs in (small Apify-green hexagon or rounded square, labeled Scraper in small Inter caps).      - 0:01–0:07 — Five destination nodes appear in sequence around it, each with a line drawing from the center outward. Stagger   them ~1s apart:                                                                                                                  - Dashboards — bar chart glyph                                                                                                 - Data pipelines — stacked layers / flow arrows
    - AI agents — a small node-cluster or spark glyph                                                                              - Marketing tools — megaphone or send-arrow
    - CRM enrichment — contact card glyph                                                                                        - 0:07–0:08 — All five connected, gentle pulse along the lines (data flowing outward), brief hold.

  Motion: lines draw on with a quick spring, destination nodes scale-in after the line reaches them. Soft ambient drift on the   whole composition so it doesn't sit still.

Fix: position labels purely outward from the node center along the angle, at a fixed distance, and drop the marginTop hack. Replace the label block inside the destinations .map(...) with: // distance from node CENTER along the outward angle const labelRadius = destNodeSize * 0.78; const labelCX = destNodeSize / 2 + Math.cos(dest.angle) * labelRadius; const labelCY = destNodeSize / 2 + Math.sin(dest.angle) * labelRadius; and render the label as:
{dest.label}
Also bump the orbit radius slightly so labels never collide with the central node — change const radius = base * 0.32; to const radius = base * 0.36;. Result: each label sits a consistent short distance directly outward from its node, never overlapping the node or floating off into the canvas.
